events.title: William Basinski + Purelink + Windy & Carl
events.description: AGE OF REFLECTIONS presents composer William Basinski (joined onstage by ambient legends Windy & Carl) in a live laptop performance of his most iconic work: The Disintegration Loops. Assembled from decayed tape recordings in September 2001, it’s an elegy for the lost, shrouded in time and mystery. Electronic trio Purelink opens. We’ll hold the ceremony in a magnificent cathedral, bathed in a projection-mapped light show, transforming the space ― and ourselves.

events.title: Make Art! Not War.
events.description:
Feeling optimistic?

Come join @detroitantiwar at @thehighdivehamtramck spinning 90s gothic bangers and make some prints!

Starts at 8, and it’s a pay what u can with a recommended donation of between 5-10$

All proceeds go to the Sameer Project (per the website) :

“The Sameer Project (TSP) is a rapid-response mutual aid initiative that supports the most vulnerable communities in Gaza. Founded in April 2024 by three Palestinians in exile, the project was a response to the gap between “intention” and actual delivery of necessary aid in a way that preserves the dignity of displaced families in Gaza.
We prioritise communities that were disenfranchised even before the genocide; encampments and areas with little to no access to outside advocacy. Through our large network of teams in Gaza, we listen to what these communities need and provide urgent support so they can continue to resist the genocide and strive for liberation.”
